name: S2-COMPRESSED-ACT row 7: Emerald Hill act 1, a short enclosed tunnel, then the opening 4576 px of Chemical Plant act 1
note: TWO ZONES, ONE ACT, NEVER ON ONE SCREEN (owner ruling S2ACT-SEAM-CORRIDORS). Left to right: ALL of Emerald Hill act 1's painted crop, x 0..10975 (to its signpost stretch and 320 px past Sonic 2's own camera box at 10656); an 832-px ENCLOSED TUNNEL x 10976..11807; the first 4576 px of Chemical Plant act 1 (its own x 0..4575), x 11808..16383, lowered 256 px, running to the act's right edge. Each zone is drawn in its OWN palette through its own region (tools/clip_rom_bake.py's ROW 7 block); the palette cross-fades at x = 11392, the tunnel's middle. WHY THESE RECTANGLES — every one is a ROM-ROOM decision first. (1) ROM ROOM USED TO BIND; SINCE S2CLIP-CPZ-LONGER IT DOES NOT: every byte a clip act adds lands below the Z80 bank anchors, and this clip carries its OWN pair (anchors.toml beside this file, owner ruling d-35-revised, derived by tools/clip_anchors.py --derive from both clip shapes), so growth moves the anchors instead of failing; map.toml's 0xA8000 does not apply to this clip. (2) CHEMICAL PLANT IS ITS FIRST 4576 PX, from its own start, because the player enters where Sonic 2 starts the zone. 4576 = 8 sections x 2048 - 11808: the clip runs exactly to the act's right edge, so nothing of the act is unpainted and the player meets the act's own right bound (Player_BoundsInit) on ground. It was 2048 px, then 2528 (S2CLIP-CPZ-LONGER, the 480-px void filled). THE WIDTH IS WHERE THE PLAYER CAN ACTUALLY RUN, NOT WHERE SONIC 2 GOES (owner, S2CLIP-CPZ-FURTHER: "fix the floor-hole check, then extend as far as Sonic can actually run"; then "as far as he can run in cpz"). The clip carries none of Chemical Plant's objects (plane-switch lines, spin tubes, boosters, pipe springs) and the player never leaves plane A. MEASURED on a 6624-px build (docs/research/2026-09-25-cpz-traversal/cpz_traverse.py, headless, 13 drives: held RIGHT from rest, at top speed and at the cap, jump-when-stuck, jump-and-spindash, 8 random explorers): nobody passes act x 15399 (Chemical Plant x 3591, feet y 768), where plane A has a solid wall from about y 600 to 1024 that plane B does not have (Sonic 2's route there is on plane B). The first section edge at or past that point is 16384, so the clip ends there: 985 px behind the wall are painted but out of reach, which is the section quantum's price and the no-void rule's. The 34 RULE-B floor pinholes that stopped the 6624-px attempt are all unreachable (docs/research/2026-09-25-cpz-floor-gaps.md); RULE B now counts only a gap a reachable standing player's ledge probe sees (tools/collision_consistency.py), and this width carries 18 candidates, all cleared. The collision is Sonic 2's, byte for byte. (3) EMERALD HILL TAKES ITS WHOLE 10976-PX CROP (S2CLIP-TRUNCATION, +3,386 B, measured when row 7 landed). (4) CHEMICAL PLANT IS LOWERED 256 PX so its start floor meets the tunnel's: see its unaligned_dst_reason. (5) THE TUNNEL IS AS SHORT AS THE ENGINE ALLOWS (owner, 2026-09-25: "Can we make the connector a little shorter, I think having it so long takes away a bit from the dramatic effect"). Two checks bound it, both from engine constants: Z2 puts the crossing at the gap's middle rounded down to 16 and needs CAM_SCREEN_HALF_W 160 + PAL_FADE_FRAMES 16 x CAM_MAX_X_STEP 16 = 416 px of tunnel each side, so 832; Z1 needs TILE_CACHE_COLS - 1 = 79 cells (632 px) between the zones and gets 104. Z2 binds; tools/test_clip_two_zone.py holds this width to the shortest that passes both. It was 1312. (6) THE TUNNEL HIDES THE BACKGROUND (owner, 2026-09-25: "the tunnel to transition has to be like an FG hiding the bg"): a solid ceiling from y 512 to 672, the walkway 672..767 (96 px), the floor from 768 down to 1023, and every pixel of the rectangle painted. It is drawn in Chemical Plant's own art ("the fg can use ehz or cpz art") RECOLOURED onto CRAM line 0, the one line no region install writes, so it is the same picture under both palettes and through the fade; drawn on a Chemical Plant line it would be on screen in Emerald Hill's colours until the crossing. wall_src is a 32x32 piece of CPZ's riveted panels, back_src its X-lattice mesh, dimmed. The 32x32 wall (not the whole 128x128 panel) is a ROM decision: the full panel measured 584 B over the DEBUG shape's room. The rectangle starts at y 512 because no camera inside the tunnel sees higher (test_clip_two_zone derives the bound: ceiling + BALL_Y_RADIUS - CAM_Y_DEADZONE - CAM_SCREEN_HALF_H = 542), and painting y 0..511 cost ROM for rows nobody can see from inside. (7) THE SEAM STEP IS GONE: Emerald Hill's ground at its crop edge is shape 164 (height 12, surface y 772) against the tunnel floor at 768 — the 4-px step the owner hit. clip_manifest K6 MEASURES it and makes the tunnel's first block the bank's gentlest ramp from 12 to 16 (shape 208): the surface runs 772 -> 768 over 16 px, never more than 1 px per column. HOW THE TUNNEL LOOKS IS THE OWNER'S CALL.

unpainted_remainder.why: NOTHING OF THE ACT IS UNPAINTED ON X: x_from = 16384 = grid_w 8 x SECTION_SIZE 2048, the act's own width. Chemical Plant's clip runs exactly to the act's right edge (Emerald Hill 10976 + tunnel 832 + Chemical Plant 4576 = 16384), so there is no remainder to fall into; the player is clamped PBOUND_RIGHT_MARGIN short of that edge on painted ground (on plane A he never gets that far: a wall at x 15399 stops him, see the note). Until S2CLIP-CPZ-LONGER, Chemical Plant was 2048 px and x 13856..14335 was an unpainted 480-px void; it was then 2528 px to the 7-section edge. Kept as a two-sided declaration: clip_reachability.py refuses if the painted world ends anywhere else; this object also carries the unbounded_fall and floorless_columns declarations below.

donor_bottom_boundary.note: each donor level's own bottom y (s2_donor.level_size); Chemical Plant is pasted 256 px lower, so its boundary would sit at y=2080 in this act

unbounded_fall.why: THE ACT STILL HAS NO BOTTOM, in all three parts. 2000 of the 2048 painted columns have air below their LAST landing surface: Emerald Hill's 1324 (its 1372 painted columns less the 48 of its two pits — s2_ehz_boot's 1232 plus the 92 columns of the recovered crop), the tunnel's 104 (its floor ends at y=1024 and the act runs to 6144), and Chemical Plant's 572, every one of its 4576 px (its clip ends at y=2304). It was 1684 with Chemical Plant 2048 px wide (256 columns) and 1744 at 2528 px (316). The other 48 are Emerald Hill's two pits, counted in floorless_columns instead. Sonic 2 survives this with a level bottom boundary that kills and restarts; this engine has no death, so a body under the terrain falls forever. THE COUNT IS THE CHECK: add a floor, a death plane or a bottom boundary and it drops, and this gate says so.

floorless_columns.why: EMERALD HILL ACT 1'S OWN TWO BOTTOMLESS PITS, x 4672..4863 and x 9472..9663 — faithful donor content, exactly as s2_ehz_boot declares them (see its floorless_columns note). Neither the recovered crop x 10240..10975, nor the tunnel, nor Chemical Plant's first 4576 px adds one (re-measured when it was widened from 2048, and again at 2528 and 4576): every column there has a landing surface on plane A. Plane B stays informational (unreachable: no crossover mark).

clips.unaligned_dst_reason: x: Chemical Plant starts where the 832-px tunnel ends (11808 = 10976 + 832), which is not a section boundary — act section 5 holds Emerald Hill's crop end, the tunnel and Chemical Plant's first 480 px (W3; the bake refuses a local map past 2047 and did not). y: Chemical Plant is lowered 256 px so its start floor meets the tunnel's. Its own start ground is a full block at y=512 (s2disasm startpos/CPZ_1.bin puts the player at (96, 492), feet at 511); the tunnel's floor is at y=768, one collision row above Emerald Hill's ground where its crop ends (x 10960..10975: shape 164, height 12, surface y=772 — bridged by the tunnel's seam ramp, clip_manifest K6). 768 - 512 = 256, a multiple of R12's 16-px collision quantum, so the paste moves art and collision together. The price is 256 px of Chemical Plant in the act's second section row (2048..2303), measured at 1,600 B of blocks when the clip was 2048 px wide (not re-measured at 2528 or 4576).
